summary: Triton International Ltd filed a Form 6-K, the foreign private issuer equivalent of a quarterly report (10-Q), for the period ending March 31, 2026. The filing contains interim financial statements, MD&A, and various disclosures about concentrations, equity components, and share-based compensation. There is no mention of a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or any other special-situation transaction. The filing is a routine earnings update with no corporate event triggering a special-situation classification.
